example.title: Save an employee through a repository bean
description: The tabs contain all application files for this separate Maven project.
The example requires Java 17 or later, Maven and PostgreSQL with an existing `employee_notes` database.
`database/schema.sql` creates the tables in an empty database before `mvn spring-boot:run`.
Hibernate validates the supplied schema. It does not create the tables.
explanation: Spring supplies the generated `EmployeeRepository` bean to the service constructor.
`save` uses the mapping to insert the employee and return an entity with its assigned ID.
The service contains the application operation.
Each inherited repository write method has transaction settings.
A transaction spanning several calls is explained after queries.
